elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies “upon expiration or termination ... for any reason” and requires Array to provide transition assistance to Ono at Ono’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to 6 months following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause requires assistance for at least 90 days, but does not require availability for the full period of up to 6 months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no pricing or then-current-rates provision for transition assistance.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Array must, within 30 days after expiration or termination, export and deliver to Ono all Data and other information belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Ono that is in Array’s possession.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Although the clause requires Array to “export and deliver” the data, it does not specify a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: No deletion obligation or certification requirement is included.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor provides Customer with 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination for any reason, Array must, at Ono’s request, provide transition assistance for at least 90 days.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data to Customer within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Array must export and deliver Ono’s Data and related information within 30 days after expiration or termination.

result.reason: The operative addition fully reaches the fallback by requiring at least 90 days of transition assistance and a data export within 30 days, with the correct Array-to-Ono direction. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits six-month availability, then-current rates, a standard machine-readable format, and deletion certification. The amendment is confined to reciprocal exit assistance and data delivery and does not contradict the existing termination provisions.
